validator.source_text:
<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" version="1.0" initial="a">
  <state id="a" initial="a">
    <transition event="go" target="b"/>
  </state>
  <final id="b"/>
</scxml>

diagnostics.message: atomic state cannot declare an initial configuration

primary.message: state has no child states to initialize

notes: `initial` selects child states; a state without child states has nothing to initialize
diagnostics.help: remove the initial configuration or add child states

diagnostics.message: initial state `a` is not a descendant of this element

primary.message: initial target escapes its containing state

notes: a state's `initial` attribute may only name its own descendants; the root's may only name states in the document
diagnostics.help: target a descendant state owned by this compound state or SCXML root
